name: Market Risk
description: Trading-book risk: VaR, expected shortfall, sensitivities, stress, and backtesting.

dimensions.name: risk_factor
dimensions.description: Risk-factor class (rates, credit, equity, FX, commodity)

metrics.name: var
metrics.description: Value at risk at a stated confidence and horizon

metrics.name: expected_shortfall
metrics.description: Average loss beyond the VaR quantile

metrics.name: sensitivity
metrics.description: First-order sensitivity to a named risk factor

metrics.name: backtesting_exceptions
metrics.description: Days where the loss exceeded VaR

metrics.name: limit_utilization
metrics.description: Risk measure divided by its limit

conventions.rule: Always state confidence, horizon, and lookback for VaR and ES (e.g., 99%, 1-day, 1-year).
VaR and ES are not additive: the firm total is less than the sum of desks; show the diversification benefit.
A single scenario's losses add across desks because the scenario is the same.

insight_rules.reason: Use component or incremental VaR, not additive contribution.
Same as VaR: sub-additive, use component allocation.

caveats.text: VaR moves when the historical window rolls volatile days in or out, even with no position change.

chart_conventions.rule: Plot daily P&L against negative VaR with exceptions highlighted.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
